name: Content Redundancy
fact: Content redundancy increases learning outcomes and decreases cognitive load.
boundary: Distinguished from modal redundancy in multimedia learning materials. TENSION WITH effect-mm-15-redundancy-effect-c1c7ed537b36: that proposal's cited sources report a mixed, largely negative-direction finding for redundancy broadly (including one "reverse redundancy effect" result matching this proposal's positive direction, for foreign-language learners) — whether redundancy helps or hurts learning is NOT resolved by this corpus. Both proposals are kept as a preserved disconfirmation (rule 4), not reconciled.
